_readme: THIS IS YOUR PRICE LIST — the only file you ever edit to change prices or payment links. Save it and every phone sees it instantly, no restart. RULES: africa packs need a "credits" number; world items need "plan": "pro". "payLink" is the secure payment page for that product: paste your Paystack or Flutterwave PAYMENT LINK (free to create once your merchant account passes KYC) — while it says ASK-IN-HALL the app shows a 'link drops soon' state and nothing can be bought. "price" is display text, type exactly what players should read.
